title: disabled due to the competition's active submission limit
note: authorName field is empty in Kaggle API output for this topic (API quirk, no usernames returned). WebFetch returned no rendered content (JS-rendered page). Content below is complete from CLI.

messages.content_html: I submit 5 notebook ， My highest-scoring notebook shows "disabled due to the competition's active submission limit."
messages.content_text: I submit 5 notebook, My highest-scoring notebook shows "disabled due to the competition's active submission limit."

messages.content_html:
You may only have two active submissions at a time - those two submissions will play episodes against others in the competition. If you submit a new one, the older ones are disabled, and your two most recent ones are active.

In order to have your highest-scoring notebook active, it must be re-submitted.
